fixes.finding: History authorization and data were read in separate statements without visibility in the data SELECT.
fixes.reproduction: A separate connection revoked private-team membership after the initial guard. The original query returned a protected event.
fixes.resolution: Apply live visibility in the data SELECT and recheck empty results to deny revoked pagination and clear old client entries.

fixes.finding: UTF-16 truncation could split a supplementary character and make PostgreSQL reject valid command metadata as invalid JSONB.
fixes.reproduction: Actual issue creation with a 199-character prefix plus emoji in the actor name and editing a milestone with a 999-character prefix plus emoji both failed before the fix.
fixes.resolution: Bound history text without retaining a cut high surrogate; cover actor snapshots, legacy names, and both property-change values.

ui: Resolve project and subscriber history values to current names; unavailable members display Former member.

browser.environment: local production Node build with two authenticated sessions and isolated acceptance database

validation.changedFileLint: zero errors; pre-existing warnings in older modules

limits: Production migration and release occur after the final reviewed head passes preview checks. Existing unverifiable events are not backfilled.
